rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The waters that came upon the earth and took them all away
content.ART_PROMPT: Black water surging through the open doorway of a stone house, a wooden bowl and a clay jar spinning on the flood, rain hammering the drowned threshold, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, storm light under a bruised green-grey sky, one shaft of silver breaking through
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Each player puts every card from that player's hand into Sheol. Then each player draws one card from the Tower and you draw four cards from the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: And the flood was forty days upon the earth
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: knew not until the flood came, and took them all away
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 7:17 — “And the flood was forty days upon the earth”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Matthew 24:39 — “knew not until the flood came, and took them all away”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Hebrew keeps a separate word for this water: mabbul is never used of an ordinary river in flood.
Psalm 29:10 is the one place outside Genesis that uses it - the LORD sitteth upon the flood, still enthroned over it.
Peter reads the flood as a figure of baptism: the same water that destroys the world carries the ark.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
